facts.fact: Scrooge 在门外盯着门看，觉得那扇门仿佛在回望他
facts.anchor: the door seemed somehow to gaze back at him

facts.fact: 他在眼角瞥见一点微光般动静，是古老衣物的窸窣声
facts.anchor: the merest glint of movement, a rustle of some ancient clothing

facts.fact: 他断定那不是 Marley，而是 Marley 已回到阴阳之间
facts.anchor: have surely returned to the world that lies between
knocked three times upon the door

facts.fact: 开门的 Captain Ambrose 双目清澈发白、没有瞳孔，像遭过可怕事故
facts.anchor: were clear white and pupilless as though he had been the victim of some dreadful accident

facts.fact: Scrooge 问上尉是否被人操纵
facts.anchor: I do believe you’re being controlled, aren’t you?

facts.fact: 上尉身体可见地抽动，像真正的 Ambrose 想传递讯息
facts.anchor: the true Ambrose were trying to communicate

facts.fact: 那个声音请 Scrooge 进去，说主人在等
facts.anchor: Come inside, my master is waiting

facts.fact: Scrooge 问屋内主人是否是 Mr Gowing
Scrooge 跨过门槛的那一刻，雪完全停了
facts.anchor: the snow ceased entirely to fall
